001: Shota, are you free this Friday?
Friday is fine for me. Do you have something in mind?
I want to go see a new movie. Would you like to come along?
Sounds good. What time does it start?
It starts at seven. Let's meet in front of the station at six thirty.
Got it. I'm looking forward to it.
002: Misaki, can we meet next Tuesday?
Tuesday is a bit difficult. The afternoon would be okay though.
Then, how about the café in front of the station at three in the afternoon?
That sounds good. Three o'clock works for me.
So, let's meet at the café at three on Tuesday.
Yes, I'm looking forward to it.
003: Takuya, do you have plans tomorrow evening?
I don't really have any plans tomorrow evening.
If you'd like, how about having dinner together?
That sounds nice. Where are we going?
There's a good Italian restaurant near the station.
I definitely want to go. What time should we make it?
004: Sakura, would you like to go shopping this weekend?
Sure. Which is better for you, Saturday or Sunday?
Then, let's meet at the east exit of the station at ten.
Got it. See you on Saturday.
005: Kenta, would you like to study at the library next Wednesday?
I have class on Wednesday morning, but I'm free in the afternoon.
Then, how about the library starting at two in the afternoon?
Sounds good. Let's meet at the library entrance at two.
Okay. I'll make sure not to forget.
006: Yuki, would you like to go to a concert on the third of next month?
Wow, that sounds great. Whose concert is it?
It's a concert by a band that I like.
I definitely want to go. Do you already have tickets?
Yes, I have two. I'll give you one.
007: Daisuke, do you have time this afternoon?
Sorry, I have a meeting this afternoon.
I see. Then, how about tomorrow morning?
Then, let's meet in front of the station at ten tomorrow.
Sure. Is there something you want to talk about?
008: Ai, would you like to go see a movie this Thursday?
I get off work late on Thursdays.
Is that so? About what time do you finish?
I finish around seven. I'm free after that.
Then, how about a movie starting at eight?
Sounds good. Eight o'clock works for me.
009: Shota, would you like to play tennis next Saturday?
Sure. But, did you reserve a tennis court?
Not yet. Shall we reserve one together?
Yes, please. I'd prefer the morning.
Okay. I'll book it from nine to eleven.
Thank you. I'm looking forward to it.
010: Misaki, would you like to go to the art museum this coming Sunday?
The art museum? That sounds nice. What exhibition is there?
There's a special exhibition of Impressionist paintings.
Wow, I definitely want to see that. What time shall we meet?
How about in front of the museum at ten?
Sounds good. Let's meet at ten on Sunday.
